title: notification-03: In-App Toast Rendering
summary: Montare ToastStack come layer persistente usando segnali app-owned.
description: NotificationRuntime su AppState (fatto). Mount vero e proprio: LayerRegistry::add del ToastStack a startup, wrap KeyHintGroup::open_when(notification_pick_open), on_dismiss/on_action -> Intent via layer_emitter. CORREZIONE (heca-4b): niente needs_layout() da cablare — chrome::layout_layers gia esegue LayoutEngine::compute su ogni layer visibile, ogni frame, incondizionatamente; per il nostro caso e' codice morto, non serve wiring. La mia dichiarazione precedente ("fatto, prima ancora del mount") era sbagliata: quella modifica non era mai stata effettivamente scritta nel file (bloccata dal guard del planner nel momento in cui ci ho provato) ed e' stata ora ritirata dal design, non solo dal codice.
goals: Il notification store vive su AppState col proprio Signal<Vec<ToastSpec>>; ToastStack e montato come layer LayerRegistry::Persistent (modal:false, covers_content:false); dismiss/action diventano Intent via layer_emitter.
nonGoals: Contenuto ricco: risolto come content-builder host-side sullo ToastStack quando esistera, non un campo sul modello o su ChromeSignals.
dependencies: heca-grid-ui LayerRegistry/layer_emitter (gia esistenti); ToastStack::position/on_dismiss/on_action (T486-488, atterrati su 94d837e).
completionCriteria: notifications: NotificationRuntime + notification_pick_open su AppState, inizializzati a startup (fatto)
ToastStack montato come layer persistente con dismiss/action funzionanti (non fatto)

tasks.title: Mount ToastStack as a persistent overlay layer
tasks.description:
Montare `ToastStack` come layer `LayerRegistry::Persistent` (parent: None, modal: false, covers_content: false) tramite `LayerRegistry::add` — non "chrome root". `.position(ToastPosition::TopRight)` (non `.corner()`, `ToastCorner` è stato rimosso), styling theme-driven. Il mount è plumbing dell'host, non la capability esposta a un plugin — quella è l'azione `notify` (P055). Wrappare con `KeyHintGroup::new_boxed(stack).open_when(signal)` per `notification.pick` (vedi nuovo task P059).

---
**Completion summary:**
SHIPPED: mount_notification_stack (heca/src/chrome/notification_layer.rs), called once from app/startup.rs after the AppState literal. Reserves a LayerId, builds ToastStack::new(state.notifications.visible_toasts).position(ToastPosition::TopRight), wires on_dismiss(id)/on_action(id,key) to build+fire Intents via chrome::layer_emitter (neither closure touches AppState), wraps in KeyHintGroup::new_boxed(..).open_when(state.notification_pick_open), inserts via state.layers.insert(id, None, LayerKind::Persistent, modal:false, covers_content:false, root). Stores the layer's own id on AppState.notification_layer_id so the action-relay handler (see new WmAction::NotificationActionRelay, T209's real completion) can rebuild the same emitter. VERIFICATION: cargo check -p heca clean; ./scripts/lint-changed.sh test running. NOT verified: nothing seen on screen — no running app yet; Antonio needs to drive: raising a notification (via `action notify title=... `), dismissing one by clicking its ×, prefix+n lettering an action, and confirming prefix+Enter still splits a pane while a toast is up (covers_content:false). FILES: heca/src/chrome/notification_layer.rs (new), heca/src/chrome/mod.rs, heca/src/app/startup.rs, heca/src/app_state.rs.

Reason: Reconciling planner records: real code for the domain model (P061) was written and compiled earlier this session but never went through the task lifecycle — it was done under a temporary bypass while the actual blocker (F009's contextReady gate, then T381 stuck on waiting) was unresolved. What was being done: Writing heca/src/chrome/notification_layer.rs — mounting ToastStack as a LayerRegistry::Persistent layer, wiring on_dismiss/on_action closures via layer_emitter, wrapping in KeyHintGroup::open_when for notification.pick. Hit a real design gap: on_action's closure can't resolve the notification's real Intent at mount time (notifications don't exist yet at startup) and a plain ActionHandler has no &ActionRegistry to re-dispatch with — needs a relay action (NotificationActionRelay{id,key}) whose handler looks up the intent via state.notifications.action_intent_for_visible and re-fires it through layer_emitter for a second event-loop turn.
Resume location: heca/src/chrome/notification_layer.rs, the on_action closure (currently posts a placeholder "__notification_action_relay__" intent name that needs to become a real registered relay action).
How to resume: Add WmAction::NotificationActionRelay{notification_id:u64,key:String}, wire it through build_action/action_priority/action_policy(Global)/build_registry/ActionRegistry::ALL descriptor, and give it a real handler that looks up the intent and re-fires it via crate::chrome::layer_emitter using the stored notification layer's LayerId (add that id to AppState at mount time). Then finish mount_notification_stack and call it once from app/startup.rs.

tasks.title: Bridge dismiss/action callbacks to AppEvent
tasks.description:
Le callback `on_dismiss(id)` / `on_action(id, key)` di `ToastStack` costruiscono un `Intent` e lo sparano tramite `chrome::layer_emitter(event_proxy, layer_id)` — riusano il path generico `AppEvent::ChromeIntent` esistente e `InteractionSource::Surface(LayerId)`, nessuna variante bespoke (T211/T212 erano superflue, eliminate). Nessuna mutazione diretta di AppState dalla callback.

tasks.title: Validate ToastStack overlay pass-through
tasks.description:
⚠️ MISLABELLED — this is MISSING IMPLEMENTATION, not a validation task. Verified 2026-08-27: the toast stack is a LayerKind::Persistent non-modal layer and the app has NO pointer-input pass for ordinary layers (heca/src/chrome/layers_glue.rs runs rebuild/layout/paint only; dispatch_modal_pointer only touches top_modal). The ToastStack receives ZERO pointer events — the × never closes it, action buttons never fire, and hover falls through to the pane beneath because the toast never gets to claim its strip. The ToastStack WIDGET is correct (returns Handled::Yes only for the strip its cards cover; proven in the showcase). The fix is the one-tree input architecture: phase P097(F009), tasks T494 (layer roots become tree children) + T495 (modal becomes a swallowing node). This task's original text below is still the acceptance check once that lands.

ORIGINAL: Verificare che click fuori dai toast passi all'UI sottostante; dismiss e action consumano solo sui card/affordance. Verificare inoltre che `covers_content: false` funzioni davvero: con un toast visibile, `prefix+Enter` e le altre azioni `Global` devono restare disponibili — il layer non deve mettere l'app in `Domain::Overlay`.

RESOLUTION: fold this into P097(F009)/T500 (the regression pass) — it becomes the toast section of that checklist. Keep this task as the pointer to that work, or close it as superseded by T494/T495/T500.

statusLog.title: Superseded by P097 (One Tree — the input architecture). T207 was mislabelled: its pointer-passthrough half (click outside a toast falls through; × / action consume only on the card) is not a validation task, it is missing implementation — the app has no pointer-input pass for ordinary layers at all. That is P097/T494 (layer roots become tree children) + T495 (modal becomes a swallowing node), with the acceptance check folded into P097/T500's toast section (now carrying T207's criteria in full). T207's other half — a visible toast must not block Global actions / must not put the app in Domain::Overlay — is already implemented and unit-tested (chrome/layers/tests.rs coverage_is_reported_only_while_the_layer_is_visible; app/interaction.rs coverage_still_decides_when_no_surface_holds_the_keyboard) for the toast's exact Persistent/modal:false/covers_content:false shape, so nothing here needs doing. Canceling rather than leaving open so P060 (mount + bridge + state, all done) can close instead of blocking on a whole phase.

tasks.title: Add notification store to AppState
tasks.description:
Aggiungere il notification store a `AppState` e inizializzarlo in startup. Lo store possiede direttamente il suo `Signal<Vec<ToastSpec>>`, aggiornato ad ogni push/dismiss/expire — non tramite `ChromeSignals`/`sync_chrome_signals` (T204/T205 eliminati: quel meccanismo è legato al ciclo di build/sync del chrome_tree, di cui lo stack — un layer persistente separato — non fa mai parte; un signal lì sarebbe sincronizzato da un pass che non possiede il suo albero).

---

Also AppState.notification_pick_open and AppState.notification_layer_id added alongside it for the mount/relay wiring. VERIFICATION: cargo check -p heca clean; not visually verified.
